 *
 * Crafting for the pyrotechnic half of the mod. The glow sticks and chem lights
 * are deliberately absent: see the crafting block in the generator for why.
 */

module Base
{
    /* A flare from nothing: an oxidiser, a propellant and a striker composition,
     * rolled into a paper tube and taped. Fertiliser is the nitrate, because the
     * game has no saltpetre, no sulphur and no strontium. Everything here is
     * built from what Build 42 actually ships. */
    craftRecipe LugliEL_CraftRoadFlare
    {
        timedAction = Making,
        time = 200,
        Tags = AnySurfaceCraft,
        category = EmergencyLights,
        NeedToBeLearn = true,
        MetaRecipe = lugli:pyrotechnics,
        AutoLearnAny = Reloading:4,
        SkillRequired = Reloading:2,
        xpAward = Reloading:10,
        inputs
        {
            item 1 tags[base:sharpknife] mode:keep flags[Prop1;MayDegradeVeryLight],
            item 2 [Base.GunPowder],
            item 2 tags[base:fertilizer],
            item 1 [Base.SheetPaper2;Base.Newspaper],
            item 2 [Base.DuctTape],
            item 1 [Base.Matches;Base.Matchbox],
        }
        outputs
        {
            item 1 LugliEmergencyLights.RoadFlare_Red,
        }
    }

    /* THE REASON THE SPENT ITEM EXISTS. A burnt flare is a tube with a cap on it,
     * which is most of a new flare. So this costs no paper, no tape and no knife,
     * at half the skill and three fifths of the time. Carrying the litter home is
     * meant to be worth doing. */
    craftRecipe LugliEL_RepackRoadFlare
    {
        timedAction = Making,
        time = 120,
        Tags = AnySurfaceCraft,
        category = EmergencyLights,
        NeedToBeLearn = true,
        MetaRecipe = lugli:pyrotechnics,
        AutoLearnAny = Reloading:4,
        SkillRequired = Reloading:1,
        xpAward = Reloading:5,
        inputs
        {
            item 1 [LugliEmergencyLights.RoadFlare_Spent] mode:destroy flags[ItemCount],
            item 2 [Base.GunPowder],
            item 2 tags[base:fertilizer],
            item 1 [Base.Matches;Base.Matchbox],
        }
        outputs
        {
            item 1 LugliEmergencyLights.RoadFlare_Red,
        }
    }

    /* A whole road flare goes into one cartridge, and that is the price of the
     * gun staying the premium tool rather than the cheap one. */
    craftRecipe LugliEL_CraftFlareCartridge
    {
        timedAction = Making,
        time = 150,
        Tags = AnySurfaceCraft,
        category = EmergencyLights,
        NeedToBeLearn = true,
        MetaRecipe = lugli:pyrotechnics,
        AutoLearnAny = Reloading:6,
        SkillRequired = Reloading:3,
        xpAward = Reloading:15,
        inputs
        {
            item 1 [LugliEmergencyLights.RoadFlare_Red] mode:destroy flags[ItemCount],
            item 1 [Base.Aluminum;Base.AluminumScrap;Base.AluminumFragments],
            item 2 [Base.GunPowder],
        }
        outputs
        {
            item 1 LugliEmergencyLights.FlareCartridge,
        }
    }
}
